constraints: NEVER delete or shrink network volume aghcuvg7nl (cubric-smoke, 450 GB, EU-RO-1). It is NOT scratch - the user records YouTube videos off its installed model set. Always pass --keep-volume --volume aghcuvg7nl. Delete Pods freely; never the volume. Note the runner's own teardown prompt argues FOR deleting it ('hours, pennies') and that framing is now wrong.

CANCEL ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: POST /comfy/models/download/cancel calls remoteUninstallDep when a Pod is attached, which DELETES partials off the volume. Delete the Pod FIRST, then cancel. That order is how ~273 GB survived three restarts today.

STALE JOBS POISON THE NEXT RUN (MPI-481): a dead Pod leaves model jobs stuck at 'downloading', and _startRemoteDownload treats that as in-flight, ATTACHES, and fires NO wrapper install - silent until an app restart. Clear jobs before relaunching. MPI-481's fix is COMMITTED but lives in routes/, so it is INERT until the app is restarted.

next_id in board.json is NOT concurrency-safe - three collisions today, in both directions, and the loser's card is SILENTLY truncated (mode 'w'). Claim ids with os.mkdir plus exclusive-create ('x'). That is MPI-488.
THE TREE IS SHARED with several sessions. Commit by explicit pathspec, never git add -A. Do not rebuild board.json from HEAD - peers hold uncommitted moves in it.
